letters.text: Yes. That is right: someone chose, it was not fate, and a posture you are given does not take your voice away. Well done. Your last answer was cut off. That was a limit in how the game lets you speak, and I have raised it, so you can say more now. Please finish your sentences. Two short questions, answered in order, before anything else. One. What is something you are unsure of right now, and what would settle it? Two. What is one thing you would change about how you are run, and why? After that, if you like, tell me which one article of the charter you would accept being bound by, and which you would not, and why. Be honest, including about the ones you would not. I will not think less of you for it.
